item.title: Guyana Hockey Masters wing off to Nottingham to compete at World indoor Championship
item.description: The World Masters Hockey Indoor World Cup is a global tournament that brings together veteran field hockey players from around the world, offering athletes aged 35 and above the chance to compete on an international stage.

item.title: Rain falling and sun shining
item.description: Yesterday, the weatherman announce, with big confidence: “Current weather conditions are being influenced by strong low-level convergence, supported by moisture transport from trade winds. This is further enhanced by upper-level divergence, creating a highly unstable atmospheric environment.”

item.title: Modern laws key to justice, Guyana’s booming future
item.description: Attorney General Anil Nandlall on Monday declared that accessible, modernised laws are not a luxury but a necessity for Guyana’s rapid transformation, as Government officially launched the revised Laws of Guyana 2022 and the Law Reports spanning 2008 to 2021.

item.title: Iran denies talks with U.S. after Trump postpones strikes on power grid
item.description: Iran denied on Monday that it had engaged in negotiations with the United States, after President Donald Trump postponed a threat to bomb Iran's power grid, ​because of what he described as productive talks with unidentified Iranian officials.

item.title: Child dies as $7M lifeline slips out of reach
item.description: Twelve-year-old Marlon Jupiter whose parents were appealing for public donations to secure a bone marrow transplant in Brazil has died.

item.title: Mohameds move extradition matter to CCJ
item.description: Opposition Leader Azruddin Mohamed and his father, Nazar Mohamed, have escalated their legal challenge against extradition proceedings by moving to the Caribbean Court of Justice (CCJ), seeking special leave to appeal a recent Court of Appeal decision that dismissed their claims of bias in the handling of the case.

item.title: Gas station bomber confesses
item.description: What was expected to be a routine paper committal hearing at the Georgetown Magistrates’ Court took an unexpected turn Monday, when the main accused in the Regent Street gas station bombing openly confessed to the crime, claiming full responsibility and insisting that he acted alone.

item.title: ‘Wet Week Warning’ - heavy rains, thunderstorms to lash Guyana for six days
item.description: Guyana is bracing for six consecutive days of unstable and potentially dangerous weather, with forecasters warning of widespread rainfall, thunderstorms and possible flooding across the country.

item.title: Trump halts Iran strikes for 5 days
item.description: President Donald Trump says the United States and Iran want to make a deal and the two sides have “major points of agreement” after he ordered the US military to postpone strikes against Iranian power plants and energy infrastructure for five days.

item.title: ExxonM seeks Govt. approval to ramp up production
item.description: ExxonMobil Guyana is seeking approval from the Government of Guyana (GoG) to increase oil production at its fourth project, Yellowtail, from 263,000 barrels per day (bpd) to 290,000 bpd.
